what: Draws waveform bars that look the same for the same seed, and fills the played part (from the left) in the accent color as the playhead passes. With ‹scroll›, page scroll is the playback position. With ‹loop›, it passes by itself once per 16 beats and pauses while off screen. When first seen, the bars rise from .05x over two beats.

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.seed: Shape seed, default 1 — with the same seed, two tracks look like the same song

use: — The fill color is --fx-wave-on (default accent color)

from.where: shared.js fillBars·waveValues · index.js gauge [data-wave] --p · service.js initAB .ab-lane · initTree [data-playhead]
